ideas.title: PBC Schema Validator
ideas.description: Automatically validate incoming W2/HR/Time Tracking data against expected schemas before processing. Flag missing fields, wrong data types, and anomalies. Could integrate with Alteryx as a pre-processing step.

ideas.title: Smart Field Mapper
ideas.description: AI-assisted tool to suggest field mappings from client column names to standard wireframe formats. Learn from previous mappings to improve suggestions over time.

ideas.title: Nuance Database
ideas.description: Searchable log of data nuances encountered and how they were resolved. Build institutional knowledge that persists across projects and team members.

ideas.title: Status Email Composer
ideas.description: Generate Thursday status update emails from an activity log. Track work throughout the week and auto-compose summaries for each project.

ideas.title: Workflow Recommender
ideas.description: Based on data characteristics and project type, suggest which workflow approach to use. Could analyze PBC files and recommend WF1-4 configuration.

ideas.title: Q/NQ Classification Helper
ideas.description: Assist with qualifying/non-qualifying percentage decisions. Provide guidance based on expense type, department, and historical patterns.

ideas.title: Data Quality Dashboard
ideas.description: Score and visualize PBC data quality across dimensions: completeness, consistency, accuracy. Track quality trends over time by client.

ideas.title: ET Response Library
ideas.description: Templates for common ET questions and communications. Pre-written responses for frequent nuance explanations, status updates, and data requests.

ideas.title: Process Timer
ideas.description: Track time spent on each workflow phase. Identify bottlenecks and opportunities for optimization. Generate effort estimates for new projects.

ideas.title: Alteryx Documentation Generator
ideas.description: Auto-document Alteryx workflows. Extract tool configurations, data flow, and logic into readable documentation for handoffs and reviews.
